organization_note: International Business Machines Corporation, incorporated in New York, has its principal executive office in Armonk, New York. It develops the Granite models, publishes them under its ibm-granite organizations, and serves them through watsonx.ai; watsonx Orchestrate is its agent platform. BeeAI Framework began at IBM but was contributed to the Linux Foundation, so it is not listed here. One name, IBM, covers the models, the service, and the platform.
